_note: Constrained grid search (w_min=0.20, w_max=0.80, step=0.05) selected LSTM=0.80/ARIMAX=0.20 for deployment robustness. Unconstrained optimum is LSTM=0.95/ARIMAX=0.05 (near LSTM-only); LSTM alone achieves lower test RMSE (9.58 vs Hybrid 10.22). The hybrid is deployed because the ARIMAX component provides a linear anchor that stabilises predictions when LSTM encounters out-of-distribution surges. This is the same config used by the 72h pipeline (artifacts/models_72h/hybrid_config.json).
alignment_note: Aligned on shortest tail overlap between model outputs.
